metadata.land_mask_attribution: Boundaries: BPS, OCHA ROAP via HDX COD-AB Indonesia (CC BY 3.0 IGO). Simplified and regrouped to Kepmendagri 300.2.2-2430/2025 codes.
metadata.projection: The exact Mercator parameters saved in the national SVG geometry package; clipping performed in its projected plane.
metadata.interpretation: Render geometry only: source historical reconstruction clipped to modern mapped land for coastline alignment. This does not validate historical frontiers or imply sovereignty. Use the untouched source GeoJSON for original research geometry.
metadata.operation: Independent polygon intersection against the union of canonical national SVG land; no simplification, snapping, source repair or modern internal-boundary inference.
metadata.land_mask_fill_rule: Nonzero per province path, then union; identical to base-map SVG and terrain canvas fills.

modern.interpretation: Annual post-transition display: West New Guinea is excluded from Indonesian reconstructed administration before 1963. East Timor is included only for 1976–98, explicitly as unrecognized occupation/annexation; 1999 is shown after withdrawal and UN transition, not as 2002 independence. Source reconstructions do not establish uniform effective control. Modern reference coastlines do not assert historical frontiers. No source frame is extrapolated past 2024; 2025 onward uses separately attributed current references.

metadata.interpretation: Modern reference coastline only, not evidence of sovereignty or effective control in an earlier year. Country label points are cartographic placements, not capitals.
metadata.display_operation: Reference land outside the national base only, preventing duplicate 3D surfaces; original Timor-Leste reference geometry remains separately available.
